## 1. Security card `c6c33374` (P1, M1, due 2026-11-19) — 2 proofs
```
# restart the API, then:
grep -E "JWT signing secret validated|InsecureKeyLengthWarning" <api log>
wc -c settings/secret.json
```
Expect: the validated line present, NO `InsecureKeyLengthWarning`, size grown 19 → ~65 bytes.
Then one live login that mints and validates a token under the new key.

## 2. `820c9052` / `42bdacee` — why pytest collects nothing
```
cd api && timeout 60 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/chat/test_single_response_per_chat.py --collect-only -q
```
If exit 124 (timed out):
```
cd api && timeout 120 .venv/bin/python -X importtime -c "import codx.junior.api.chat" 2>&1 | tail -40
```

## 3. Rollback question on `c6c33374` (answer yes/no, does not need a command)
`ensure_signing_secret()` "rejects legacy secrets" — does a pre-existing 19-byte `settings/secret.json` get **regenerated silently** (safe upgrade) or does startup **fail fast** (every existing deployment refuses to boot after upgrade)? If it fails fast, the card is not launch-ready and needs a migration step before it ships.

**Acceptance:** the raw output of 1 and 2 pasted into this card, plus a yes/no on 3. I then apply the verdict to the three cards the same shift and close them.

**Why one card:** three separate asks were written across three cards across three shifts and none was answered. One card, one paste.
